slice: Current-source ARM64 Kernel application software smoke
source_tree: working-tree snapshot based on the source commit; includes the Delphi service boundary files listed below

build.command: docker buildx build --progress plain --platform linux/arm64 --target kernel --build-arg KOKONUT_CLICKHOUSE=false --load --tag kokonut-kernel-current-arm64-delphi-boundary:local --file Dockerfile.kernel .

runtime_smoke.command: docker run --rm --platform linux/arm64 --network none --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=64m -v <repository>/sdk/python:/sdk:ro -e PYTHONPATH=/sdk -e PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 --entrypoint python3 kokonut-kernel-current-arm64-delphi-boundary:local -u -c '<assert ARM64, Gateway route-tree counts, JobSpecs, and imports>'

limitations: QEMU software-emulation evidence only; no physical Raspberry Pi, power-loss, thermal, measured performance, or storage-endurance acceptance.
The container had no network, a read-only root, a 64 MiB temporary /tmp, and only a read-only Python SDK source mount.
Gateway construction and route-tree inspection do not exercise authenticated requests or live providers.
